0.original: ...Chi-Chi? Is this the right way to your old man's castle?

1.original: Goku, he's my father, not an old man. For that matter, he's your father, too.

3.original: Your father-in-law, at least once we get married!

4.original:
Whoa! Man, the Ox-King's gonna be my dad, huh?!

That's... weird.

5.original:
I have to admit, though, I'm impressed. I never thought you'd get this strong.

No wonder I figured you'd be the perfect husband.

6.original: Ugh, you still don't remember me? I'm Chi-Chi! Daughter of the Ox-King!

8.original:
Aaaaagh! Now I remember!

Oh, man, I really said it, too! I told you I'd marry you!

10.original:
(Now it makes sense...)

(I thought that a wife was some kinda food or something.)

(Ah, well... a promise is a promise!)

15.original: By the way, Goku, I think it'd be best if we held a marriage ceremony soon...

17.original: Yes. A ceremony worthy of the greatest son-in-law a king could ever hope for.

18.original: Oh, we don't need one! It'd be so embarrassing! Right, Goku?

19.original: Huh? I don't really care either way, but...

20.original: Chi-Chi... there's something I'd like to show you.

23.original: Ah, here it is! Here, take a look!

28.original: It's a wedding dress. Your mother wore this when we got married.

30.original: I keep it here as something to remember the ol' lady by.

32.original: Chi-Chi... I'd like you to put this on during the big day for me.

33.original:
Oh, Daddy! We've just got to have a ceremony now!

I can't wait to put this wedding dress on for myself...

Let's do it! Right now! I'm ready anytime!! ...Huh? Goku!!

34.original: Uh... Chi-Chi? Do you really have to wear that dress to get married?

36.original:
There's no need for haste here, Chi-Chi.

We'll need the villagers' support if we want to set up the greatest wedding ceremony in the land!

38.original:
Ladies and gentlemen... uh... Thank you for, er, coming...

Er, I mean, for taking time out of your busy schedules...to, uh, make it to our wedding.

39.original: Ha hah! Perfect! My wedding speech is gonna be great! Now we just need good weather!

41.original: Goku! I left my wedding dress in Daddy's room!

43.original:
I'll take care of the dress, Goku!

You get Chi-Chi out of here for me!

47.original: Whoa! Man, it's so hot! I can't get any closer!

50.original: Goku! Use your Kamehameha to put out the flames!

54.original: You'll blow the whole castle apart! Just like Master Roshi did before!

56.original: Don't worry, okay? I'll make it just strong enough to put out the fire!

61.original: Chi-Chi! You wait here, okay? I'll save him!

62.original: Oh, man...! This isn't any ordinary fire!

66.original: Goku! The Bansho Fan's the only thing that'll put these flames out!

68.original:
Yeah! It's the greatest fan in the world!

Wave it once for a massive gust of wind... Wave it twice for clouds, and three times for rain!

69.original: But Master Roshi threw it away! He was using it as a pot holder, and it got all dirty!

70.original: I don't care, Goku! You've got to find that Bansho Fan for me! Pleeeease!

71.original: ...But where could it be? I have no idea!

72.original: ...Wait. Who do I go to when I'm stuck like this?

73.original:
That's it! Fortuneteller Baba!!

Chi-Chi! I'm gonna go visit Baba, okay?

76.original: Hey, uh, Baba...? Could you tell me where the Bansho Fan is?

77.original:
Ahh-choo!! Great, I've caught my first cold in 200 years...

Ohh, I hardly feel like moving... Ahh-choo!!

80.original:
I don't know where the Bansho Fan is...

But it appears Fire Mountain's eruption has something to do with the Magical Furnace.

82.original:
Yep! There's a furnace that lies under Fire Mountain, you see...

The flames from it are what you see spouting out of the mountain right now!

I can't see anything else... You'll have to go check out the furnace for yourself.

83.original: Really? Well, okay! So how can I get to it?

84.original:
I heard there was a path leading to the furnace from Mt. Five Element...

It's being protected by a very, very important person. Her name's Annin!

Perhaps she might be able to tell you what's going on here.

85.original: Mt. Five Element, right? Thanks a lot!

86.original:
Wow... this is the Magical Furnace?

Man, it's huge!

88.original:
...Who on earth would you be?

How am I supposed to sleep with all this racket?

90.original: Annin... I haven't heard anyone call me by that in a while.

92.original: Listen, there's something I need you to do! Put out the furnace's fire for me!

93.original: Whaaaaaat?! You want me to quell the flames?

94.original: Daddy's surrounded by the furnace's fire! He's trapped!

96.original: My name's Chi-Chi, daughter of the Ox-King...

97.original:
...The Ox-King lives on Fire Mountain?

Hmm... that's the mountain behind this one, isn't it?

That must mean there's a hole or something at the bottom of the furnace.

98.original: Please! You've got to put out the fire!

101.original: Shutting the furnace down would cause chaos both here and in the Other World. Do you want that?

102.original: It'd certainly be interesting, to say the least, but...

104.original: Please! We need to put out the furnace before it's too late!

105.original: ...You want to see the world messed up that much, do you?

106.original: If that fire isn't put out, the Ox-King's gonna burn to death!

107.original: Come on, you need to help! Save my father for me!

108.original: So you want to plunge the world into turmoil in order to save a single man's life?

109.original:
I... I don't know, okay?!

Just tell me how to shut off the furnace already!

110.original:
Heavens! You certainly have a lot of spunk, at least!

You wanna shut the furnace down? Just turn that knob over there all the way down!

That'll put it out for sure, I guarantee!

111.original: Before that, though, let me test you to see how serious you really are!

113.original:
Look up, above the pot!

Do you see all the steam rising up from it?

115.original:
That steam turns into fog and settles at the top of the mountain!

And that's where the problem lies here, Goku!

117.original:
Uh-huh.

If the furnace shuts down, that fog's gonna disappear, too!

119.original:
That fog's actually the portal between this and the Other World!

Everyone that dies in this world goes through that fog to the Other World...

And people in the Other World can come back through at times to see their kids and so on.

120.original:
But with the furnace off, the fog's going to lift...

The souls of the dead or visiting won't be able to make it to the Other World anymore.

The world will be filled with wandering, vengeful souls!

It'd plunge the entire world into a panic! Don't you see?

121.original:
Well, why don't we just turn the furnace off for a little bit, Annin?

Just enough to keep the steam from going completely away?

123.original:
Once the furnace is extinguished, it takes over 2000 years to start it up again!

It'll be a dark, dark era for those millennia... Does that sound like something you want?

124.original: Well, how can we keep the flames from shooting out from the furnace?

125.original: C'mon, you gotta help us! There has to be some way!

126.original:
Well... there is one method.

Have you ever seen one of these before?

127.original:
...Whoa! The Bansho Fan!

Wow, lady, you had it the whole time!

128.original:
Um... lady, you say?

Listen, kid, who do you think I am, anyway?

I am Annin, the great overseer. I have guarded this furnace for thousands of years!

129.original:
Whoa! Thousands of years?!

Man... you aren't a lady, you're an old grandma!

130.original: ...You little brat!! There are some things better left unsaid, you know!

131.original: What? You wanna fight me again, or what?

132.original: Hee hee hee... Oh, I'm already fully aware of your skill by this point, thanks.

133.original: Great Annin! Tell us how we can save Daddy already!

134.original:
You'll need more than the Bansho Fan to put the furnace out...

You'll also need something to plug the hole at the bottom of the furnace.

135.original: Oh... what, is that it? Well, I'll go fetch whatever you need!

136.original: I'm afraid what we need is not so easily obtainable...

139.original: The bottom of the furnace is made from the shells of the eggs laid by the fire-eater bird!

141.original:
That's right. So we'll need a shell to plug the hole with...

And we'll need honey from an octogonal beehive to hold the shell in place, too.

142.original: Wow... so an eggshell and some honey, huh?

143.original: So where can we find these things, Annin?

144.original:
The fire-eater bird lives on Kiwi Volcano, I think.

And as for the honey... er...

146.original:
I've forgotten... I haven't needed any for thousands of years, you see.

I'd be willing to bet Master Roshi would know, though.

148.original: All right! I'll go off and find that shell and the honey for you!

149.original:
Good! Try to be quick as you can about it!

We'll need those two things before we can do anything else!

150.original:
Hey! Hey, Turtle Hermit!

Could you tell me where there's an eight-sided beehive at?

151.original: Ah, Goku! What on earth have you been up to?

152.original:
Ah... I see...

Well, I heard there's a lady named Hakkake who collects that honey. She lives near Mt. Frappe.

153.original: Thanks, pops! Guess that's where I'm going next!

156.original:
I can't even imagine what kind of danger I'm gonna be facing from here on in...

I can't afford to have you exposed to all of that.

157.original: O-okay... but are you sure you're gonna be okay by yourself, Goku?!

158.original: No problem! I can handle the search, easy!

160.original:
I heard the whole story, Goku.

If Chi-Chi's dad is in trouble, there's no way I'm not gonna help, too!

161.original: ...Hey! I'm not gonna let you hog all of the limelight! Take me along too, Goku!

162.original: Krillin... and Yamcha? Well, sorry, guys, but...

163.original: Hold on a minute, Goku. You better not be forgetting about me!

165.original:
Right! Let's get moving!

There isn't a single moment to waste!

166.original: A fire-eater bird's shell and some honey, eh...? It'll be a cinch with all of us helping!

168.original:
You can now view your S-Combos via the Crystal Ball in the menu!

This S-Combo dictionary lets you view all of the S-Combo notes you've acquired.

These notes contain hints on how you can put S-Combos together into bigger combos.

There are S-Combo notes hidden around the world. Try to find them all!

170.original:
If you value your life, give me that egg!

When we want something, we get it, and that's that!

172.original:
...Uh, wait. Emperor Pilaf?

Am I going at it alone here?

175.original: Wow... so this is a fire-eater bird's egg.

176.original:
Great! Now we just need to take the shell back.

We better hurry... I'm getting worried about the Ox-King.

180.original: I'm honestly astounded you actually found an egg from that bird...

181.original: Sorry, pal, but we're taking that sucker, shell and all!

183.original: Quit messing with us! We're never gonna let you have it!

184.original: There's someone you oughta meet before you start going off like that!

185.original: A man feared in every corner of the dark underworld!

186.original: Robbery, murder, speeding, extortion, pickpocketing, dine 'n dash...

188.original: His name...? None other than Emperor Pilaf!

192.original:
Well, look at this! What a fine egg I see here!

It's the only one of its kind in the world! I could sell it for 100 million Zeni, easy!

193.original: And with that kind of cash, my dreams of world conquest will finally become reality!

194.original:
Ah ha ha ha hah!

This egg is mine! All mine!!

195.original: Hmm... hey, have I seen you somewhere before?

196.original: Yeah... I was just thinking that myself.

203.original:
Whoa, wait a sec... I think I just remembered!

Y-y-you're... G-Goku!

206.original: Guess we won't be seeing them again. Time to go home!

207.original: What brings you to this frigid place, my friends?

208.original:
Gah! Forget about us! What are you doing in a place like this, old lady?

We're looking for someone named Hakkake! She's supposed to live somewhere around here.

209.original: Oh...? And what will you do once you meet her?

210.original:
Well, it's kind of a long story...

But the gist of it is that we want a little bit of the honey she has!

211.original: ...Gah! You rabble are after my honey as well, are you?!

213.original: I most certainly am... But guess what, guys! There ain't no honey left!

215.original:
I love eating shaved ice with honey on top... I get the ice right here on Mt. Frappe.

But these three weirdos came earlier and stole all of my honey!

217.original:
Hey, how about we do this, lady?

If we can get your honey back, would you mind giving us just a little?

218.original: Get my honey back...? Well, I'd be happy to, if you can find it.

219.original:
Great! Thanks a lot, lady! We'll have it back here in a flash!

So where did those three guys go?

220.original: They were climbing up Mt. Frappe last I saw them!

223.original: You stole some honey from Hakkake, didn't you? I'm here to get it back!

224.original:
...Emperor Pilaf?

I think they're after the legendary sweet honey we stole!

225.original:
If we get our honey stolen back from us...

We can forget about selling it for the cash we need to conquer the world!

227.original:
Ha hah!

You want that honey? Well, come right on up here and get it! Thpbbt!

229.original: You got it! I'm counting on you, Mai!

231.original: There are so many enemies out there! Do we have any kind of strategy, Emperor?!

233.original: Whaaaaa?! What am I supposed to do?!

235.original:
Ugghh! You guys don't know when to give up!

Shu! Mai! Get them!

236.original:
Gee whiz, guys...

We could've avoided all this if you had just handed it over.

238.original:
Oh! Hakkake!

We got the honey back for you, ma'am!

239.original:
Really? Oh, my! Thank you so much!

I made you a promise. Here's a bit of honey for you!

241.original:
And so Goku, with the fire-eater bird's eggshell and honey in hand, made his way back to Kame House.

There he regrouped with Chi-Chi to pay another visit to Annin and the furnace...

242.original: Here you go! The honey, and the eggshell!

243.original: Impressive! It didn't take you much time, either!

244.original: Now we can plug the hole in the furnace, right?

245.original:
Not so fast, kid!

There's only a one-in-a-million chance that it'll even work, I'm afraid...

247.original: ...And if you mess up, you'll be dead for sure!

248.original: Well, I'm still giving it a shot! What do I have to do?

249.original:
Hmm... if anyone can do it, it's got to be you, Goku.

I'll lift up the pot a little bit, so you'll go into the furnace and plug the hole in the meantime.

250.original:
I gotta go inside the furnace?!

Oh, man! It's gotta be scorching in there, right?

I dunno about this anymore...

251.original: Well, that's where the Bansho Fan comes in!

252.original:
Listen, Goku...

If you flap the fan once, you'll part the flames with the wind and make a path for yourself!

Follow that path down to the bottom, and you'll be able to patch up the furnace.

It'll be dangerous, Goku... you willing to risk your life for it?

254.original:
Goku...

There are flames raging all across the furnace... The hole's probably deep inside, too!

255.original: ...Got it! I'll dive in as far as I can go!

256.original: Go then, Goku! There isn't a moment to lose!

257.original: Oh, man...! Where the heck is it?!

260.original: I better get back before I burn up!

261.original:
Gokuuuuu! Oh, Goku, I'm so glad you made it in time!

I thought you were a goner for sure...

262.original: This ought to make the fire go away in the castle, right?

264.original:
Thank you, Goku!

Sorry for the trouble, Chi-Chi... As overseer of the furnace, I formally apologize!

265.original:
Thanks to Goku's bold efforts, the fire in the Ox-King's castle was extinguished.

With that, Goku and Chi-Chi were able to hold their marriage ceremony.

266.original:
Listen up, everyone! Thanks for coming to celebrate my marriage!

Ohhh, this makes me so happy!

267.original:
...Wow, Chi-Chi, you're beautiful.

You're an even match for your mother, in fact!

268.original:
Thanks again for the wedding dress, Daddy!

I'll never forget this moment...

269.original: Take good care of her for me, Goku.

271.original: With their ceremony over, what could be waiting for Goku and Chi-Chi ahead? Happiness, or...?

272.original:
How about I tell your fortunes, instead?

Hoihoihoi!!

273.original:
Let's see... Ahhhh!

Oooh, this is troubling indeed...

274.original: And so the story skips forward five years...

275.original: W-w-whoa! What was that?! A meteor? A UFO?

276.original: The inhabitants of this planet are still alive... Curse you, Kakarot.

278.original: Power level... only 5, huh? Piece of garbage.

279.original: G-get away from me! I, I, I'll kill you!

281.original:
Hmm?

There's someone far more powerful nearby... range, 4800. Is that Kakarot?!

282.original:
!!!

W-where did this power come from?! It's intense, and it's coming right this way!

It couldn't be Goku, could it?

Oh, no...!

284.original: And who are you? You got a problem with me?

285.original: I don't need to deal with the likes of you.

286.original: So what're you here for?! You in that much of a hurry to die?

287.original:
Heh heh heh... that's a big mouth you've got there.

Hmm... power level 322, eh? Quite a range of humans live here, I see.

But you're still no match for me...

288.original:
What?!

Do you have any idea who you're talking to, you freak?!

291.original:
What a worthless move... All it did was kick up some dust.

Now it's my turn, huh? Let me show you a real move...

292.original:
!!!

I sense another power nearby! It's massive!

293.original:
That way...! Range, 12,909...

This one's big... the biggest power source on the planet! It must be Kakarot!

294.original:
Huff huff...

It... it can't be! I... I was shaking so much, I couldn't even move!

295.original: Kakarot! Have you thrown away your pride as a Saiyan, the great warrior race in the universe?

299.original:
My goodness, it's been ages! Ages!

I tell you, you kids are so ungrateful! It wouldn't kill you to come visit more often...

300.original: Here you are! Just a little gift, some of your favorite meat buns.

301.original:
Oh, my! You really shouldn't have...

Couldn't you have just let me have something more... personal?

302.original: Ngh... you never did have much of a sense of humor.

303.original: And you never had much in the way of dignity, you creep!

304.original: By the way, Bulma, do you know where Yamcha is?

305.original:
What? Yamcha? That idiot? How should I know, huh?

He crossed me one too many times, so I didn't tell him we were all meeting here today!

We can party it up just fine without him, okay?!

306.original: You two certainly seem to enjoy arguing a great deal...

307.original: Wait a minute... What about Launch, though? Where's she?

308.original: She ran off somewhere. She's been chasing after Tien for five years now.

316.original: You start a babysitting service or something?

320.original: Well, yeah. What's so weird about that? Come on, son, say hello to everyone.

324.original: Gohan?! My, you named him after your late grandfather!

326.original: There's something coming this way! I don't know what, but it's something big!

328.original: W-wow... I can feel this huge, intense power! What the heck could this be?!

331.original:
Heh heh heh... you've grown, Kakarot, but I still recognized you right off.

You look just like father, after all...

332.original: Uh... who is this guy? What's he talking about?

333.original:
Kakarot! What is wrong with you? Just look at this planet!

Your mission was to eradicate humanity! Why have you wasted so much time?!

334.original:
Listen, I don't know who you are, but you better get out of here, now!

Sheesh... I wish people wouldn't start drinking so early in the day.

337.original:
!!!

A... a tail!

This guy's got a tail...!

338.original: Heh heh heh... Have you recognized me yet?

340.original:
Are you kidding me, Kakarot? Have you forgotten absolutely everything?!

Hey, did you take a blow to the head or something?

341.original: You can stop calling me Kaka-whatever anytime, you know! My name's Goku!

342.original: Answer me! Did you get hit in the head when you were young, or not?!

343.original:
...I did, actually!

I don't remember any of it, but it happened when I was really young. I still have a scar from it.

345.original: But what's that got to do with anything?

346.original:
Goku... this reminds me of a story your grandfather told me once.

He found a baby with a tail one day. The kid had a bad temper and kept causing trouble...

Drove the man crazy most of the time, no doubt about that.

One day, the boy fell in the valley and landed on his head. It was a wonder he survived...

But the baby was so powerful that he recovered without any permanent injury.

What's more, his bad temper went away, and he became a good, kind child.

349.original: L-look, who are you anyway?! Tell me!

350.original:
I can't believe you forgot everything... but oh well. I'll make you remember right now.

You've got a lot of work ahead of you, after all...

354.original: Be careful, Goku... this isn't any normal fighter.

355.original:
No... doesn't look like it.

Just facing him down like this is scaring me, to be honest.

I've never felt this way before.

356.original:
Right! First off, you weren't born on this planet, Kakarot!

Your birthplace is Planet Vegeta! You are a Saiyan, the proudest warrior race in the universe!

358.original: And I... I am your brother, Raditz!

361.original: Y-yeah! If Goku's a space alien, then what's he doing here on Earth?!

362.original:
Heh heh heh... the answer's simple, really.

Kakarot was sent here to destroy the human species that lives on this planet!

We Saiyans are a race of warriors...

We search for suitable planets, eradicate everyone that lives on them...

And when we're done, we sell the planets to alien races at an enormous profit.

We send adult Saiyans to planets with strong native species living on them...

But with low-level planets like these, we send babies instead, like yourself.

Luckily, this planet has a moon...

With that, you could wipe out the humans here in just a few years.

Once you get around to remembering your orders, that is!

363.original:
Oh, man... if that's true, then you guys are terrible.

It's all just so crazy... You make Piccolo seem like a saint by comparison.

364.original: ...Wait. Why is having a moon a good thing?

365.original:
Quit acting so stupid, Kakarot...

When we Saiyans see a full moon, our full latent abilities are unlocked! You know that!

...Wait. Don't tell me... Your tail! What happened to your tail?!

366.original: Oh, that thing got cut off ages ago!

367.original:
This can't be happening! You blithering idiot...!

No wonder you've actually made friends with the natives!

368.original:
I've had enough!

So what if I was born on some other planet and have a different name and stuff?

I don't even care if you are my brother. That doesn't matter to me anymore!

Krillin's right... you Saiyans are the absolute worst!!

My name's Goku, and this is my home! So get going, or else!

369.original:
Heh heh heh... I'm afraid I can't do that for you.

We Saiyans were never a very large race, but now it's even worse...

You see, Planet Vegeta is gone... It exploded after colliding with a giant meteor.

Nearly all the Saiyans were vaporized in an instant... our mother and father, too.

370.original:
There are only four Saiyans left in the universe, and you're one of them!

Me and another one were saved because we were busy invading another planet.

The third was sent off to a new world as a baby, just like you... He was lucky.

Earlier, we found the most amazing planet. We could sell it for a huge pile of money!

But it'll be hard to clean it up with just three of us...

That's when we remembered that you were still kicking around, Kakarot.

You still don't have your full powers quite yet...

But with all four of us working as a team, we should be able to manage well enough.

You have to open your eyes, Kakarot! It'll be fun! Let your Saiyan blood go wild!

371.original: You're insane! As long as I live, I swear I'll never join you guys!

372.original:
Heh... I see.

Say, I couldn't help but notice... is that your kid standing behind you?

374.original:
Don't try to fool me, Kakarot.

That tail is all the evidence I need. He's got Saiyan blood in him.

376.original:
Since you're not being very cooperative with me...

I was thinking about maybe borrowing your boy for a bit instead.

377.original: I dare you to take one step closer to me! I'll send you outta here in a heap!

381.original:
Kakarot... your kid's in our hands now.

If you want to get him back alive, you better start listening to your brother.

383.original:
I'll give you one day. That's how long you have to make your decision.

Not that you have any choice besides joining us, of course... I'll need some evidence, too.

Nothing very fancy, mind you...

Just kill 100 or so people and pile their bodies here by this time tomorrow.

384.original:
Got that? I'll be looking forward to seeing you tomorrow.

This is my nephew, after all...

I'd prefer if I didn't have to kill him. Heh heh heh...

385.original: T-that's not fair! You can't use a child like that!

386.original: H-he's right! Besides, how could Goku find it in him to kill anybody?

387.original:
Fair enough... If you don't mind him dying, then don't worry about the bodies.

Either way, the people on this planet are doomed.

Once we're finished capturing our current planet, this one's going to be our next target!

389.original:
Heh heh heh...

Three Saiyans are all it'll take to exterminate everyone on Earth within a month.

So whether Kakarot passes his little test or not, it's all the same in the end.

Got that, Kakarot?!

Fight me all you want! Joining me is your only choice!

390.original:
And don't even think about defying me, either!

Your incomplete powers are no match whatsoever for your big brother!

393.original: Well, see you later! Tomorrow's sure gonna be fun! Ah ha ha ha ha hah!

394.original: I... I'm sorry... There wasn't a thing I could do against him.

396.original: Hold it, Goku! It's too reckless! We need to think things over first!

397.original: Y-you can't go! He's going to kill you!

398.original: Do you seriously think you can beat him right now?!

399.original: Ugh... Darn it! What am I supposed to do?

401.original: Here he is! It's got to be him! Look at how fast he's going!

403.original: He stopped! Phew... he's still on Earth! He hasn't gone off into outer space yet!

404.original: All right! Well, here goes... It's do-or-die time!

405.original: I... I guess so! We might have a chance at this, after all!

407.original: If we're all doomed either way, might as well do as much as we can before doomsday arrives!

408.original: You people don't stand a chance! None of you!

413.original:
I did.

There's no way you two could beat him. I'll come along with you.

You know as well as I do just how strong he is...

Neither of us could face him down by ourselves.

But with the two of us together... there's a small chance of victory!

414.original: I guess so... but what's making you want to help me all of a sudden?

415.original:
Don't get the wrong idea... I'm not some kind of freedom fighter or anything.

I don't care what happens to your kid... That guy's just in the way of my world domination plans!

416.original:
Once I team up with you to beat him and those two friends of his...

You're next on my list, Goku.

I'll beat you down, and this time the world will be mine for sure!

417.original:
Not if I can help it...

Until then, though, I think teaming up is a great idea.

418.original: In fact, I guess it's pretty much the only way.

419.original:
Exactly... we need to be patient here, Goku.

The idea of partnering with you is enough to make me puke, but I've got to put up with it.

420.original: Hey, Bulma! Can I borrow your radar?

422.original: Think you can keep up with my Flying Nimbus?

423.original:
Don't be stupid!

My strength is in a completely different class than your silly magic tricks.

424.original: I... I'm not sure how to feel about this.

425.original:
Heh heh... well...

I have to say, I never imagined this pair-up in my wildest dreams.

426.original:
I doubt there's been a stronger tag team in the history of the world!

We might just have a chance at this one after all!

427.original:
This is gonna be one heck of a bout, I'm sure of that!

Bulma! You remember the spot your radar indicated? Let's all go check it out for ourselves!

428.original: Looks like he's going north at supersonic speed!

429.original: Hmph. Probably headed for the Spinach Wastes. That's where I first met him.

430.original:
...I'm seeing a Dragon Ball deep in the wastes.

That must mean Gohan's somewhere in there, too.

432.original: We gotta go in and get Gohan back. That's the only way.

433.original: ...Heh heh. I never thought I'd be fighting with you quite like this.

436.original: The Dragon Radar's going crazy right here!

439.original:
Shut up, you brat! Gah, how long are you going to keep crying?!

You bear the blood of the noble Saiyan race! Saiyans are not... crybabies!

441.original: Right... guess I'll go hunt for some food.

444.original: Power level 710?! It's right nearby, too! Where is it?!

446.original: Gah... this thing's got to be broken. Don't scare me like that!

447.original: We're getting close! We should probably touch down and hide pretty soon.

448.original: No, Goku! We need to keep going!

449.original: The guy's got some weird device that can measure our location and power levels!

450.original: So... so you think he knows we're close?

452.original: Hmm... I guess a full-frontal attack's our only choice, then!

453.original:
...Ah, yes.

Let me tell you something before all of you die.

The other two surviving Saiyans are even more powerful than I am.

454.original:
Ugh... no...

Two more Saiyans... and they're even stronger...

W-what are we gonna do...?

455.original:
Oh, brother...

I wish I didn't have to hear that.

457.original:
Heh heh... sorry.

Not this time, I'm sure not.

459.original:
But who cares about that! Where's my son?!

Where have you hidden him?!

460.original:
I didn't hide him anywhere.

He wouldn't stop whining, so I just put him away for a bit.

You see that hole behind you?

461.original: He's in there. Still alive, too, I think...

463.original:
Hang on, Gohan!

Daddy's gonna come help you!

464.original:
Ha ha ha ha hah!

Don't give me that!

There's no way you could possibly save him!

After all...

You're going to die before you even have a chance!

465.original:
Ha ha ha ha hah!

Looks like you're just about at death's door!

466.original:
Goku...

You have any kind of amazing new skill you could use right now?

467.original:
Heh heh... sorry.

I gotta admit, I've got nothing.

468.original:
Geh... When did you get so lazy...?

I treated my training seriously... and it's gotten me all kinds of new techniques.

469.original:
Ha ha ha hah! What're you fools going on about?!

Discuss your strategy all you want! It's worthless!

It'll be easier for both of you if you just let me kill you now!

470.original:
Wait...

So you've got some kind of amazing new technique, then?

471.original:
You could say that...

But it takes a lot of time to gather the necessary Ki.

You'll need to fight him and divert his attention until I'm ready to go.

472.original: Got it... But do you think it'll hurt him?

473.original:
It should. If it doesn't, then we've got nothing left.

Geh... I wanted to save this move for when I killed you, though.

474.original: But you're gonna save my life with it instead, huh?

475.original: Heh. If we can get this guy, it'll be your turn next.

477.original: Heh heh... This isn't a laughing matter, Goku.

478.original:
You're laughing at me...?

Defiant as always, are you?

479.original:
All right! This is gonna be fun!

I'll go hold 'em off for you!

482.original: Power level 710... Ahhh, I knew this thing was broken!

485.original:
There's one... no, two of them! Power levels 322 and 334! That'd make one of them Kakarot.

There's no way he should be here, though! He knows full well that he has zero chance of winning...

Besides, how could he even know where I am right now...?

488.original:
(Maybe it's not broken after all...!)

(But... but there has to be some reason for this!)

(How could a kid like that have a power level of 710? That's ludicrous!)

489.original: Well, well. So you were the other one, huh? How did you find me?

491.original:
Heh. Whatever. Let's try a different question, then.

What are you two here for?

492.original: Why do you think?! We're here to get my kid back!

493.original: So you refuse to join your only kin, your fellow Saiyans?

495.original: You're going to go against the wishes of your own brother?

497.original:
Kakarot... I thought you were a smarter man than that.

I can't believe you're such an idiot... What an enormous disappointment.

You didn't actually think that the two of you together could beat me, did you?

499.original: Piccolo... were you training with weights on, too?

501.original: My body hasn't felt this light in ages.

502.original: (What?! His power level's gone up to 408!)

503.original:
Wow... guess you've been training pretty seriously.

I'm sure glad I have you on my side for now.

This ought to make the fight a little easier to deal with.

504.original:
(Kakarot's up to 416...!)

Ah ha ha ha hah! You call that strong?!

505.original:
Don't make me laugh!

I can't believe that's all you've got for me! You people are in way, way over your heads!

506.original: Winning the battle isn't just about strength... We've got a plan, you know.

507.original:
Yeah, yeah... I've heard it all before.

Listen up, Kakarot: As of right now, I'm not gonna even try to be friendly with you.

You'd be nothing but a drag on all of us, that much I'm sure of...

You're an embarrassment to our entire race! Prepare to die!!

508.original: He... he dodged it! I can't believe it. He's so fast...

509.original:
That blast pierced right through my armor...

That's one impressive move. If I took the full force of it, I'd be down for sure.

510.original: ...If I can't hit with it, it's worthless.

511.original: You're gonna pay for that... I promise you will! I'm through playing around here.

516.original: You... you let your guard down. I've got your tail now...!

518.original: Now, Piccolo! Do that thing you did before!

519.original:
Oh... uh, right!

Nice work, Goku! You better hold on tight to that tail!

I can unleash that move one more time, but that's it!

520.original: K-Kakarot... you're going to kill the only brother you have in the world?

521.original:
Shut up! I told you, I don't have any brother! Not one as horrible as you are!

Besides, you're the one who was trying to kill me earlier! Don't try to talk your way out of this!

522.original:
I... I give up!

I've had a change of heart... I promise I'll leave the planet peacefully.

523.original:
Don't let him fool you, Goku!

He's just trying to cover his hide! You know he'd never do anything like that!

524.original:
P-please... believe me, my brother! I've been so terrible all this time...

But... but I swear I'll keep my promise.

525.original: Don't let go of his tail! He's trying to trick you!

526.original: I... I'm begging you, Kakarot! Believe in me!

530.original:
Haaaaah hah hah! Perfect!

It's rare to run into someone as stupid as you, Kakarot!

I can't believe you fell for that! You'll never be a real warrior, that's for sure!

532.original:
You're nothing like I am... I'm a first-class warrior!

I can kill people without even a moment of hesitation!

Care to see a little sample? Hmm?

Hyah!!

534.original: Hah! Yah! Suffer! Your death is near!

536.original:
Haaaah hah hah!

Okay, your turn! Come on, lay one on me! What's the problem? Give me another one of those blasts!

554.original: Gohan, you need to get out of here!

555.original: N-now his power level's back down to 1... It swings wildly depending on his emotions.

556.original: W-wait...! Stop it... you can't do that!

557.original:
Why not? Because he's just a kid?

Don't give me those lies! This brat's power level is higher than yours!

I'm going to kill him before he learns how to control his powers correctly!

Don't worry... you'll get to see him soon enough, over in the Other World!

558.original: You... you monster! How could you still have so much power?!

559.original: Piccolo! Give me that move one more time!

560.original:
Got it! I've got it prepared already!

It's gonna take some time, though! Why didn't you grab on to his tail?!

561.original: He... he can just rip that tail off anytime he wants!

564.original:
C-curse youuuu!! That brat's attack robbed me of my power...

Let me go, Kakarot! Don't you realize his attack will hurt you too, you fool?!

565.original: Heh heh... I'm gonna die right along with you!

567.original: This... this is the only way we have of defeating you...!

568.original:
I'm not gonna hold back for you, Goku...

Both of you dying together is the best ending I could possibly hope for!

(Geh... not that it'd be much of a permanent solution, though.)

(I'm sure your friends would just resurrect you with the Dragon Balls before long...)

569.original: Are... are you ready yet?! My ribs are breaking here... Just do it already!!

570.original: Let me go!! This... this is all my fault! I swear I won't come to this planet ever again!

571.original: You aren't fooling me with that line twice!

572.original: Okay, I'm all set... You ready to go?

577.original: Curse you all... how could I have... let you beat me...?

579.original:
Heh... heh heh heh...

I never thought... Kakarot would sacrifice his own life...

580.original: You idiot. Goku can come back to life anytime he wants.

581.original:
This planet has something called Dragon Balls... They're very useful things.

Make a wish to them, and you can do anything... even raise the dead.

582.original:
Heh... heh heh... You do realize that this is all being recorded?

The entire battle... is being broadcasted to my two friends, far away in space...

Once they realize I've been defeated... they'll come here for you...

583.original:
Y-you Earthlings are such fools...

They will come and eradicate humanity in the blink of an eye...

And maybe I'll have them... resurrect me with those... magical balls of yours...

585.original: One year... that's all it'll take them... heh heh heh...

586.original: One year... They'll be even stronger, and there's two of them...

587.original:
You'll have no chance to win... I'm sure of it this time.

Hope... hope you enjoy the year's time you have left... heh heh heh...

588.original:
Hee hee hee... a pretty short-lived victory, huh...?

You humans are nothing more than annoying flies...

590.original: That oughta put you to rest. It's what you deserve for all that trash talk...

592.original:
I see someone!

Over there! There's a few people lying on the ground! Who's that standing up...?!

593.original:
It's Piccolo!!

W-what on earth has happened here...?

596.original:
Goku! Come on, Goku!

You can't just die like this! Come on, hang in there!

597.original: Gohan's unconscious, but he looks all right to me.

598.original:
Whew... Thank heavens. Now Chi-Chi won't yell at me...

K-Krillin... it's... it's not much fun to die, is it...?

599.original: I... I guess not. Don't worry, though. We'll resurrect you as fast as we can.

603.original: Hmm... must be the work of Kami.

604.original:
He's the only one who could do something like that.

That little sneak... He's probably got some stupid plan for Goku up his sleeve again.

606.original:
Shut up! I told you, I don't have any brother! Not one as horrible as you are!

Besides, you're the one who was trying to kill me earlier! Don't give me your lies!

608.original:
Yo! Hey, it's me! Long time no see!

I kinda forgot to tell you about Ki-Blasts, so let me give you the whole story on them.

If something breakable is flashing orange, you can break it right away...

But if it's flashing white, your Ki-Blast needs to be level 2. If black, then you'll need level 3!

609.original:
Your Ki-Blast level goes up as you keep training, after certain events occur.

Best of luck out there!

610.original: Your Ki-Blast is now at level 2! Now you can destroy objects flashing white!

611.original: Your Ki-Blast is now at level 3! Now you can destroy all breakable objects!

613.original:
What a loser.

Getting killed by a bunch of guys whose power level barely broke 1000...

614.original: So, now what? Maybe we should save this planet for later...

615.original: Those Dragon Balls intrigue me... He said they can make any wish come true.

618.original: Are you kidding me? I don't need that worthless bum.

619.original:
Then how about we wish for eternal youth?

We could fight on and on, forever. It'd be great.

621.original: Still, the power Kakarot's son showed... He far outclasses any Saiyan kid I knew.

622.original: You don't think that was some kind of Scouter error?

623.original:
No. It couldn't have been.

You saw how Raditz was nearly floored by a single strike from the kid...

If I had to guess, there must be something about combining the blood of Saiyans...

...with that of Earthlings. It must unleash some sort of massive new power.

624.original:
A sort of Super Saiyan, you could say...

Interesting... if we could create more of those hybrids, then us Saiyans may yet rule again!

625.original:
Don't be stupid! What do you think would happen if more of those guys show up?

It'd just make our position dangerous. It wouldn't accomplish anything for us.

626.original: I suppose you're right... Either way, Earth's inhabitants don't have long to live!

627.original: Well... I'd say it's time for the first long rest we've had in a while.

628.original: I'll see you in a year. This is going to be so much fun!
